content.title: Ozempic 1Mg(4Mg/3Ml) 1Pen
content.text: Need Physician Approval Ozempic 1mg 1 Prefilled Pen 3ml Out of stock Ozempic (semaglutide) is used for type 2 diabetes in adults. A valid prescription is a must for medicine dispense Product Description: Ozempic is used to treat type 2 diabetes in adults by improving blood sugar levels and lowering the risk of serious cardiovascular events such as stroke, heart attack, or death in adults with type 2 diabetes who have heart disease. Ozempic has also been demonstrated in clinical trials to aid with weight loss; after 30 weeks, patients taking Ozempic 0.5mg lost 2.6 kg more than the placebo group, while patients taking Ozempic 1mg lost 3.5 kg more than the placebo group. Currently, Ozempic is not an FDA-approved weight loss medication. Uses: Improve blood sugar levels and reduce the risk of significant cardiovascular events such as stroke, heart attack, or death in persons with type 2 diabetes who have heart disease. Precautions and warnings: Call your doctor at once if you have: Vision changes. Unusual mood changes, thoughts about hurting yourself. Fast heartbeats. Symptoms of pancreatitis. Gallbladder problems. Low blood sugar. Kidney problems. Stomach flu symptoms. Side effects: Low blood sugar (in patients with type 2 diabetes). Upset stomach, heartburn, burping, gas, and bloating. Nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and loss of appetite. Diarrhea, constipation. Runny nose or a sore throat. Symptoms of stomach flu. Headache, dizziness, and tiredness. Ingredients: semaglutide. Concentration: semaglutide 1mg. Pharmacological classification: Antidiabetic agent. Number of Pens: 1pen. How to Use: Use this medicine exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Ozempic is injected under the skin (subcutaneous injection), usually once per week at any time of the day, with or without food. It usually started at a low dose that gradually increased every 4 weeks to 30 days. Storage Conditions: Store unused medicine in the refrigerator 2°C to 8°C but do not place them near the refrigerator cooling element. Once a pen is in use you can store it at room temperature 15°C to 30°C or in the refrigerator. Do not freeze. Keep away from children.
